title: Agent Admission Respond — payload
description: The candidate agent's answers to its drawn understanding criteria; the response records the understanding-gate result scored against published thresholds.

agent.description: VID of the candidate agent. MUST equal the document issuer.

criterionId.description: The drawn criterion this answer addresses.

answer.description: The agent's answer, in its own words. Verbatim reproduction of the governing policy is refused, not scored.

answers.description: Exactly the drawn criterion set — every drawn criterion, no others.

threshold.description: The published passing threshold the score was judged against.
